questions.title: The push of acme/recipes-web was refused again after one rebase

blocks.label: Why
blocks.text: Someone pushed feat/recipe-sharing first; the rebase onto it conflicted, so it was aborted and nothing local changed.

summary.needFromYou: Resolve it in a terminal, or try again

options.label: I'll resolve it in a terminal
options.why: The conflict is in TRD-web.md and needs a person
options.trade: The session ends; Continue finds the push done

options.label: Try the push again
options.why: The other push may have been a fast-forward this clone can take now

consequences: The run is not finished until both pushes succeed

notes.label: Retried
notes.text: Fetched, rebased once, aborted on the conflict
notes.engineer: git rebase --abort left HEAD at b7e1c42
